searchText: Hey all, is the block at slot 1 the first one to have attestations? or shall it be the block at slot 2? iirc the block at slot 1 has attestations with source equal to the genesis There are beacon committees assigned to slot 0 and they are expected to attest to the genesis. Slot 1 is the first validator produced block and could include the attestations from genesis (slot 0)
